coordinates.object_orientation: Head -Y, tail +Y, feet Z=0; bilateral crests separated across X.

concept.reason: Primary anatomical paper downloaded; Figure 3 fossils visually inspected. Published cranial diagnosis sufficient, no decorative concepts.

scope: Whole organism; not skull-only, not movie creature.
specimen_basis: UCMP 37302 holotype partial skull and skeleton, supplemented by UCMP 77270 and TMM specimens in Marsh and Rowe 2020. Composite living reconstruction, not an exact single-specimen scan.

scale.basis: UT research summary up to 20 feet (~6.1 m). Chosen artistic adult length, not measured complete holotype.

diagnostic_targets: Two separate parasagittal longitudinal head crests, one on each side of midline above narrow muzzle, rising toward orbital area. Visible central gap in front/top.
Long head with strong jaw volumes, S-curved neck, muscular bipedal body and long airborne balancing tail.
Preserve crest distinction from single-crest Monolophosaurus and nasal-horn Ceratosaurus. No neck frill, venom accessory, back sail or giant nasal horn.
Continuous original faceted anatomy with clear limb negative spaces and smooth volume transitions.
uncertainties: Exact external crest contour, keratin cover, skin, colour and pose remain inferred. Do not present fossil breakage as crest serration.
Holotype contains incomplete and restored bones; composite specimen reference is disclosed.
Simplified complete-body dimensions other than approximate total length are artistic, not fossil measurements.
acceptance_checks: Exactly two thin but readable lengthwise crests, separated at front/top; do not merge into one broad ridge.
Three main clawed fingers plus strongly reduced fourth digit nub; fourth is not an equally long claw. Palms inward.
Three forward major toes per foot; planted feet, attached digits, grounded coherent joints; long tail clear of ground.
Four standard views, perspective may reuse preview; no extra default image generation.
No copied third-party mesh/texture or dependency on other model folders.
handoff_contract: Same localdir for prep/maker/QA. Report COMPLETE actual files/hash to root then stop. Root handles asynchronous backup; retain local for integration, which uses local first and restores Drive only if absent. No maker upload/cleanup. New models held for later batch integration; no PR here.
